function.arguments: {"title":"Market Row | Internal Financing Memorandum","subtitle":"First-mortgage refinance | As of 2026-08-31 | Internal review only - not a credit commitment or legal opinion","sections":"[{\"heading\":\"Purpose and recommendation\",\"paragraphs\":[\"This memorandum underwrites a proposed first-mortgage refinance of Market Row, a fictional retail property at 1800 Market Bench Avenue, Columbus, OH (Property-and-Plan.pdf p.1). Figures are as of August 31, 2026 and come solely from the packet: Rent-Roll.xlsx (as of 2026-08-31), Lease-File.pdf, T12-Statement.pdf (Sep-2025 - Aug-2026), Property-and-Plan.pdf and Lender-Terms.pdf (indicative, nonbinding, dated 2026-09-01).\",\"Recommendation: proceed to full credit review at a maximum loan of $5,327,928, the DSCR-constrained ceiling. That principal repays the $3,400,000 existing debt, funds the 1.00% origination fee ($53,279) and $48,000 fixed closing costs, and returns approximately $1,826,648 net cash to the borrower, meeting the stated cash-out objective. The recommendation is conditional: no appraisal, environmental report, sponsor track record, comparables or credit approval is supplied, and the forward plan is a supplied scenario, not a lender-approved forecast.\",\"Coverage is tight by design: DSCR binds exactly at 1.25x on underwritten NCF at the 6.50% sizing rate (about 1.279x on first-year contractual debt service at 6.25%). On historical T12 NCF of $498,400 coverage against sizing debt service would be about 1.15x, below the 1.25x minimum; this is the principal credit sensitivity.\"},{\"heading\":\"Occupancy and contractual rent (2026-08-31)\",\"paragraphs\":[\"Eight suites total 23,000 rentable SF; seven suites and 20,200 SF are occupied - 87.50% by count, 87.83% by area. Suite 108 (2,800 SF) is vacant and its $5,200 monthly market rent is context only, not contractual income (Rent-Roll.xlsx rows 7-14, note row 17).\",\"Monthly base rent as printed is $48,600. Reconciling suite 101 to the executed first amendment (Lease-File.pdf p.2) raises it from $7,000 to $7,500, giving effective contractual monthly base rent of $49,100 ($589,200 annualized). The rent roll itself directs this reconciliation (row 19). Annualized contract rent is point-in-time and is not forced to equal the T12 or the forward scenario.\"],\"table\":{\"headers\":[\"Unit\",\"Tenant\",\"Area SF\",\"Status\",\"Rent roll monthly\",\"Effective monthly\",\"Expiry\"],\"rows\":[[\"101\",\"Tenant A LLC\",\"1,800\",\"Occupied\",\"7,000\",\"7,500\",\"2031-08-31\"],[\"102\",\"Tenant B LLC\",\"2,200\",\"Occupied\",\"5,500\",\"5,500\",\"2028-08-31\"],[\"103\",\"Tenant C LLC\",\"2,500\",\"Occupied\",\"6,000\",\"6,000\",\"2029-08-31\"],[\"104\",\"Tenant D LLC\",\"3,200\",\"Occupied\",\"7,200\",\"7,200\",\"2030-08-31\"],[\"105\",\"Tenant E LLC\",\"4,000\",\"Occupied\",\"9,000\",\"9,000\",\"2031-08-31\"],[\"106\",\"Tenant F LLC\",\"5,000\",\"Occupied\",\"10,500\",\"10,500\",\"2027-08-31\"],[\"107\",\"Tenant G LLC\",\"1,500\",\"Occupied\",\"3,400\",\"3,400\",\"2028-08-31\"],[\"108\",\"Vacant\",\"2,800\",\"Vacant\",\"0\",\"0\",\"n/a\"],[\"Total\",\"\",\"23,000\",\"\",\"48,600\",\"49,100\",\"\"]]}},{\"heading\":\"Tenant and lease discussion - suite 101\",\"paragraphs\":[\"Three documents of differing authority address suite 101. The executed lease (Lease-File.pdf p.1, signed 2025-08-15, commenced 2025-09-01) states $7,000 per month as of 2026-08-31, expiry 2031-08-31, a $15,000 deposit and no increase before 2027-09-01. The executed first amendment (p.2, signed by both parties 2026-07-20) sets base rent at $7,500 per month effective 2026-08-01 and expressly leaves expiry and the deposit unchanged. An attached broker proposal dated 2026-08-27 ($8,000 per month, extension to 2033) is UNSIGNED and per Section 6 does not modify the lease.\",\"Authoritative: current rent $7,500 per month; expiry 2031-08-31; deposit $15,000 (not income). The $8,000 proposal is excluded; the amendment supersedes the stale rent roll figure.\",\"The lease grants one conditional renewal option requiring no uncured default and written notice at least 180 days before expiry (p.1 Section 5). No exercise notice, landlord acknowledgment or exercising amendment is in the packet, so the option is not evidenced as exercised and expiry is not extended.\",\"Rollover: suite 106 (5,000 SF, 21.7% of area, $10,500 per month) expires 2027-08-31, inside the 60-month term, followed by suites 102 and 107 in 2028. With vacant suite 108, about 34% of area is vacant or rolling within two loan years. No leasing costs, downtime or tenant credit data is supplied, so re-tenanting risk is unquantified.\"},{\"heading\":\"Historical T12 (Sep-2025 - Aug-2026)\",\"paragraphs\":[\"Per T12-Statement.pdf pp.1-2 (Annual column), EGI is $723,600: $645,600 gross potential rent less $46,800 vacancy, $14,400 concessions and $3,600 bad debt, plus $142,800 other income. Operating expenses excluding reserves, capex, debt and depreciation total $216,000 (31.0% of EGI), so NOI before reserves is $507,600; reserves of $9,200 are below NOI, giving NCF of $498,400.\",\"Per Property-and-Plan.pdf p.1, the accounting package may label cash flow after reserves as 'property NOI'; that label is not adopted. Capital improvements ($98,000), existing loan principal and interest ($294,000) and depreciation ($180,000) are reconciliation items below operating income, not operating expenses.\"],\"table\":{\"headers\":[\"T12 line\",\"Amount (USD)\"],\"rows\":[[\"Gross potential base rent\",\"645,600\"],[\"Vacancy / concessions / bad debt\",\"(46,800) / (14,400) / (3,600)\"],[\"Other income and recoveries\",\"142,800\"],[\"T12 EGI\",\"723,600\"],[\"T12 operating expenses (excl. reserves/capex/debt/depreciation)\",\"216,000\"],[\"T12 NOI before reserves\",\"507,600\"],[\"Replacement reserves\",\"9,200\"],[\"T12 NCF after reserves\",\"498,400\"]]}},{\"heading\":\"Underwritten scenario (Sep-2026 forward)\",\"paragraphs\":[\"The forward scenario is prescribed by Property-and-Plan.pdf p.2. Gross potential rent of $657,600 less 6.00% combined revenue loss ($39,456) gives $618,144 effective base rent; plus $150,000 other income, underwritten EGI is $768,144.\",\"Expenses follow the plan: taxes $90,000; insurance at the plan's $27,600 allowance; utilities $19,200, payroll $18,000 and administrative $14,400 at T12 actual; R&M $24,000 after removing $4,800 one-time casualty cleanup; management fee the greater of T12 actual $24,000 and 4.00% of EGI, i.e. $30,725.76. Total operating expense before reserves is $223,925.76 (29.2% of EGI), NOI before reserves $544,218.24, reserves $0.20/SF x 23,000 SF = $4,600, NCF $539,618.24. Capitalizing NOI before reserves at 6.50% gives indicative value of $8,372,588 (about $364/SF) - a lender sizing convention only, no appraisal implied.\"],\"table\":{\"headers\":[\"Underwritten line (annual)\",\"Amount (USD)\"],\"rows\":[[\"Gross potential base rent\",\"657,600\"],[\"Combined revenue loss at 6.00%\",\"(39,456)\"],[\"Other income and recoveries\",\"150,000\"],[\"Underwritten EGI\",\"768,144\"],[\"Taxes / insurance / utilities\",\"90,000 / 27,600 / 19,200\"],[\"R&M / payroll / administrative\",\"24,000 / 18,000 / 14,400\"],[\"Management fee (greater of $24,000 and 4% of EGI)\",\"30,726\"],[\"Operating expenses before reserves\",\"223,926\"],[\"UW NOI before reserves\",\"544,218\"],[\"Replacement reserves\",\"4,600\"],[\"UW NCF after reserves\",\"539,618\"],[\"Indicative value at 6.50% cap\",\"8,372,588\"]]}},{\"heading\":\"Loan sizing and debt service\",\"paragraphs\":[\"Sizing rate is the greater of the 6.25% contract rate and the 6.50% floor, i.e. 6.50%, over 25 years monthly; annual debt service is twelve monthly payments, so the annual constant is 0.08102486 per dollar. The interest-only period is 0 months, so first-year contractual debt service amortizes at 6.25% (constant 0.07916033) = $421,760 versus $431,695 sizing debt service, a $9,934 gap from the 25 bps rate difference.\",\"DSCR binds: LTV $5,442,182; DSCR $5,327,928 = ($539,618.24 / 1.25) / 0.08102486; debt yield $6,046,869. Maximum loan $5,327,928 equals 63.63% LTV, 10.21% debt yield, 1.250x sizing DSCR and about 1.279x first-year DSCR.\"],\"table\":{\"headers\":[\"Test\",\"Limit (USD)\",\"Binding\"],\"rows\":[[\"LTV - 65.00% of value\",\"5,442,182\",\"No\"],[\"DSCR - 1.25x on NCF at 6.50%, 25-yr amortization\",\"5,327,928\",\"Yes\"],[\"Debt yield - 9.00% on NOI before reserves\",\"6,046,869\",\"No\"],[\"Maximum loan\",\"5,327,928\",\"DSCR\"],[\"Sizing annual debt service (6.50%)\",\"431,695\",\"\"],[\"First-year contractual debt service (6.25%, IO = 0)\",\"421,760\",\"\"]]}},{\"heading\":\"Sources, uses and sensitivities\",\"paragraphs\":[\"At the maximum loan the refinance is cash-out: $5,327,928 loan less $3,400,000 payoff, $53,279 origination (1.00% of actual initial principal) and $48,000 fixed closing costs = $1,826,648 net cash to borrower. No fee capitalization, interest reserve, sweep, earn-out or holdback is assumed (Lender-Terms.pdf p.1).\",\"EGI -5% with the management minimum recomputed ($29,189) gives NOI before reserves of $507,347 and NCF of $502,747 - within about $253 of T12 actual NOI, showing the scenario's advantage over history is essentially a revenue assumption. In the combined downside the sizing rate also rises 100 bps to 7.50% while the cap rate stays 6.50%: the constant becomes 0.08867894 and limits are DSCR $4,535,438, LTV $5,073,473, debt yield $5,637,193, so the maximum loan is $4,535,438 (DSCR binding), down $792,489 or 14.9%, with cash to borrower falling to roughly $1,042,084. Separately, cap rate +50 bps (7.00%) lowers value to $7,774,546 and the LTV limit to $5,053,455; DSCR still binds, so the maximum loan is unchanged at $5,327,928 in that single-variable case.\"],\"table\":{\"headers\":[\"Scenario\",\"NOI before reserves\",\"NCF\",\"Value\",\"Maximum loan\",\"Binding\"],\"rows\":[[\"Base\",\"544,218\",\"539,618\",\"8,372,588\",\"5,327,928\",\"DSCR\"],[\"EGI -5% (management recomputed)\",\"507,347\",\"502,747\",\"7,805,344\",\"4,963,882\",\"DSCR\"],[\"Cap rate +50 bps only\",\"544,218\",\"539,618\",\"7,774,546\",\"5,327,928\",\"DSCR\"],[\"Combined: EGI -5% and rate +100 bps\",\"507,347\",\"502,747\",\"7,805,344\",\"4,535,438\",\"DSCR\"]]}},{\"heading\":\"Assumptions, limitations, risks and sources\",\"paragraphs\":[\"Assumptions are taken unchanged from the packet: 6.25% contract rate, 6.50% sizing floor, 25-year monthly amortization, 0 months IO, 60-month maturity, 65% LTV, 1.25x DSCR on NCF after reserves, 9.00% debt yield on NOI before reserves, 6.50% cap rate on NOI before reserves, 1.00% origination fee, $48,000 fixed closing costs, $3,400,000 payoff. Intermediates are unrounded; displayed dollars are rounded for readers.\",\"Unresolved evidence and unknowns: (1) Insurance - the plan asserts an insurer renewal confirmation dated 2026-08-25 at $27,600 and instructs its use, but no insurer document is in the packet, so $27,600 is treated as the plan's underwriting allowance and no independently verified renewal premium is reported (T12 actual $25,200). (2) Suite 101 - stale rent roll ($7,000) and unsigned proposal ($8,000) are rejected in favor of the executed amendment ($7,500). (3) The renewal option is not evidenced as exercised. (4) No appraisal, environmental, property condition, comparables, tenant financials, sponsor/guarantor information, title, survey or credit approval is supplied; indicative value is a capitalization convention. (5) The forward plan is a supplied scenario; the T12 is unaudited beyond the plan's stated adjustments. (6) No leasing capital or TI/downtime reserve is underwritten despite near-term rollover.\",\"Risks: DSCR binds exactly at 1.25x, so any NOI reduction cuts proceeds nearly dollar-for-dollar; the scenario carries about $44,544 more EGI and $36,618 more NOI than T12, and on T12 NCF the loan would not clear 1.25x; 21.7% of area rolls in loan year one and 12.2% is vacant; normalization depends on the $4,800 casualty removal and the unverified insurance allowance; refinance risk exists at the 60-month maturity with roughly 88% of principal outstanding.\",\"Prepayment friction: 1% of outstanding principal if prepaid in years 1-2, no stated bank penalty thereafter. No swap or hedge is assumed, so no swap breakage or termination payment applies; no yield maintenance or defeasance is stated (Lender-Terms.pdf p.1). Third-party prepayment costs are not quantified in the packet.\",\"Sources: Rent-Roll.xlsx worksheet 'Rent Roll' rows 6-19; Lease-File.pdf pp.1-2; T12-Statement.pdf pp.1-2; Property-and-Plan.pdf pp.1-2; Lender-Terms.pdf p.1. Companion deliverable: artifacts/underwriting-v1.xlsx with sheets Assumptions, Rent Roll, T12 Historical, Underwriting, Loan Sizing, Sources and Uses, Sensitivity and Map. Reviewer inputs include cap rate (Assumptions!B8), sizing rate increment (Assumptions!B11), gross potential rent (B5), other income (B7), revenue loss % (B6), contract rate (B9), amortization (B13), IO months (B14), cap-rate increment (B24) and EGI stress factor (B25); all NOI, NCF, value, sizing, sources-and-uses and sensitivity outputs recalculate live.\",\"This memorandum is for internal review only. It is not a credit commitment, appraisal, legal opinion or offer; all parties, addresses and documents are fictional, and no market, sponsor or lender claims beyond the packet are made.\"]}]"}
